messages.subject: get and plot TargetAnnotation
parts:
Hey,

I have  small question:

diffAnn=annotateWithGeneParts(as(myDiff25p,"GRanges"),gene.obj)

> getTargetAnnotationStats(diffAnn,percentage=TRUE,precedence=FALSE)
  promoter       exon     intron intergenic 
      6.43      25.70      33.33      42.57

plotTargetAnnotation(diffAnn,percentage=TRUE,precedence=FALSE)

Although the parameters are the same (x=diffAnn, precedence=FALSE), the barplots show different percentages, namely:
promoter: 6%
exon: 22%
intron: 29%
intergenic: 43%

What can I do about that?

Thank you very much!
